item.title: Boys basketball: Region tournament updated results and schedules
item.description: The region basketball tournaments are underway with teams seeking a berth in the VHSL state tournaments.

item.title: Princess Anne girls top Kellam, book trip to state tournament in search of 16th championship
item.description: The Cavaliers play Deep Creek on Friday for the Class 5 Region A title on Kellam's floor.

item.title: VHSL girls wrestling: First-place and third-place matches in the state championships
item.description: Tallwood's Tatiana Denig recorded a second-period pin of Annandale's Darling Saravia to win her second consecutive Virginia High School League girls wrestling championship at 145 pounds.

item.title: Photos: Princess Anne girls beat Kellam to advance to state tournament
item.description: Princess Anne defeated Kellam 90-50 in the girls basketball Class 5 Region A Tournament semifinals to earn a sport in the state championship tournament at Princess Anne High School in Virginia Beach, Virginia, on February 25, 2026.

item.title: Nansemond River, Norview punch state tourney tickets with tight Class 5 Region B semifinal wins
item.description: Top-seeded Norview holds off three-time defending region champion Woodside, and Nansemond River comes from behind to surprise King's Fork to advance to next week's Class 5 state tournament.

item.title: Norfolk Admirals suffer ‘demoralizing’ defeat at home against Greensboro Gargoyles
item.description: The Admirals (19-27-2-0) remain in seventh place in the North Division, trailing the fourth-place Reading Royals by 17 points for the division's last playoff berth.

item.title: UVA QB Chandler Morris sues NCAA, seeking 7th year of eligibility
item.description: The contentious part of the case stems from the 2022 season, when Morris was a backup for national runner-up TCU.

item.title: ODU earns shutout baseball victory at Norfolk State
item.description: Jakson Walter, a freshman from Western Branch High who is one of 10 Hampton Roads players on Bridgewater's roster, had a game he'll never forget: three home runs and eight RBIs in five at-bats in a triumph at Christopher Newport.

item.title: Photos: Nansemond River and Norview earn spots in state tournament
item.description: Nansemond River beat King’s Fork 56-53 and Norview beat Woodside 55-52 in the Class 5 Region B tournament semifinals at Norview High School in Norfolk, Virginia, on February 25, 2026

item.title: High school scoreboard: No. 1 seed Princess Anne, No. 3 Deep Creek advance to girls Class 5 Region A final
item.description: The top-seeded Crabbers of Hampton defeated No. 4 Warhill 72-31 and will host No. 3 Denbigh for the 2026 Class 4 Region A championship.
